assumptions: Trips, counts, facilities, stress levels, barriers, and shared-vehicle states use documented coverage.

constraints.description: The active mobility network and micromobility schedule must respect declared labor, access, sequencing, notice, and completion windows.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: active transportation director and shared-mobility program manager
decision_question: When should vehicles be rebalanced, charged, inspected, and returned to service?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The active mobility network and micromobility schedule must respect declared labor, access, sequencing, notice, and completion windows.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for shared-mobility rebalancing and maintenance schedule passes documented checks for effective dates, time zones, calendars, lead times, completion semantics, and update cadence.

intended_claim: A versioned schedule design for comparing declared alternatives affecting shared-mobility rebalancing and maintenance schedule, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in station-hours outside vehicle availability targets
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call an optimized rebalancing route executed or a work order verified complete.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for shared-mobility rebalancing and maintenance schedule passes documented checks for effective dates, time zones, calendars, lead times, completion semantics, and update cadence.
